job_title: Quality Assurance Engineer Co-op Student (4-month contract)
education_requirements: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
key_responsibilities: Design, develop and execute automated test scripts
Conduct peer review of automation test scripts and provide corrective actions
Identify, analyze, track and manage detected automation system and program errors
Report automation development statuses and findings to Test Automation Lead and/or project team
Optimize test automation scripts to reduce technical debt and improve performance
Work with project teams and business subject matter experts to identify test cases suitable for automation
Provide input into design, creation and maintenance of Test Automation Framework and automation guidelines
Collaborate with DevOps team to incorporate test scripts into CICD pipelines

company_research.summary: Foresters Financial is a mid-sized fraternal life insurance provider with 1,001–5,000 employees, operating across Canada, the US, and the UK for over 150 years. The company has a stable "A" (Excellent) financial rating and is known for its focus on community investment, though recent reviews on Glassdoor (3.1/5 stars) suggest mixed sentiment regarding management transparency and career growth. For the QA Co-op role, applicants will work with modern tools like Selenium, Playwright, and Azure DevOps in an environment that emphasizes automated testing and CICD integration.
